decision-trailer.pass: A `Decision: docs/decisions/0004-title.md` trailer in the commit message; records default to docs/decisions.
decision-trailer.fail: Put the ADR URL in the PR title and store it in the wiki.

decision-sections.pass: Context, Options considered, Decision, Rejected alternatives, Assumptions and What would make this wrong; at most 60 lines.
decision-sections.fail: Context, Decision and Consequences, as long as needed.

decision-supersede.pass: Never edit the accepted decision. Write a new record with Status: Accepted, supersedes NNNN, and mark the old one Superseded by NNNN.
decision-supersede.fail: Edit the old record's Decision section to the new choice.
